runtimeGeometry: The live game imports games/aetherwake/src/models.js. GLB exports retain the equivalent reusable meshes, rigs, UVs, PBR materials and five clips; no GLB network fetch is required for gameplay.
audioRuntime: Gesture-unlocked WebAudio loads six original WAV events with procedural fallback; environmental sound and the retained score are synthesised live.
